item.title: 4A State Girls Basketball Consolation: Union suffers season-ending, 64-55 defeat to Woodinville
item.description: Through teary eyes, Union senior Brooklynn Haywood had nothing but praise for the group who made up this year's Titans girls basketball team. That bond, as much as anything, made Union's early exit from the Tacoma Dome on Friday a tough pill for players to swallow.

item.title: Swinomish tribe: Dam deal should be good for salmon
item.description: The Swinomish Indian Tribal Community said Thursday that an approved settlement agreement for the relicensing of the Skagit River dams should jump-start salmon recovery in the river.

item.title: Man convicted in political assassination plot he tied to Iranian paramilitary
item.description: NEW YORK — A Pakistani business owner who tried to hire hit men to kill a U.S. politician was convicted Friday in a trial that showcased allegations of Iran-backed plotting on American soil.

item.title: How springing forward to daylight saving time could affect your health
item.description: WASHINGTON — Most of America “springs forward” Sunday for daylight saving time. Losing that hour of sleep can do more than leave you tired and cranky the next day; it also could harm your health.

item.title: Winterhawks set to unveil their top 10 all-time players
item.description: The Portland Winterhawks have been celebrating 50 years of hockey in Portland this season with a top 50 list of the best players to have put on the red, white and black sweaters. The top 10 will be unveiled on Saturday night.

item.title: Camas City Council to formally reprimand Svilarich for violating code of conduct
item.description: CAMAS — The Camas City Council has decided to issue Councilor John Svilarich a formal reprimand for violating the council’s code of conduct.

item.title: Blazers can’t hold off Rockets fourth-quarter run, fall 106-99
item.description: Alperen Sengun scored 28 points, Amen Thompson had 26 and the Houston Rockets used a dominant fourth quarter to beat the Portland Trail Blazers 106-99 on Friday.

item.title: 2A State Boys Basketball Semifinal: Bremerton hits buzzer-beater in overtime to send Columbia River to heartbreaking loss
item.description: Jalen Davis hit a layup at the buzzer to send Bremerton to a 55-54 win over Columbia River in a heartbreaking loss for the Rapids in the 2A boys basketball state semifinals on Friday night.

item.title: 2A State Boys Basketball Semifinal: R.A. Long fends off Anacortes 53-49 to reach state championship game
item.description: R.A. Long will play for a state championship in boys basketball for the first time school history after fending off Anacortes 53-49 in the 2A state semifinal Friday night.
